verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of Authy or Twilio publishing independent security audits of the app or its sync protocol. The only security-related item is a first-party claim that backups are encrypted and decrypted only with the user's password, which is a feature claim, not an independent audit. Because the axis applies to an authenticator app and nothing supports it, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the vendor publishes independent security audits of the app and its sync protocol
